proof.caption:
The real deployed shelf starts with healthy Alpha and the explicitly synthetic Broken delete failure fixture.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-29e1a604cd5e918d7382569b.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

The deployed app reports that Broken delete could not be read and clears the reader instead of showing stale text.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-29e1a604cd5e918d7382569b.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

The failed delete is reported without false success; Broken delete remains available for retry after authoritative D1 reload.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-29e1a604cd5e918d7382569b.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

Sandbox-local Chromium renders the complete one-screen shelf at the loopback origin and visibly reports that its unseeded local storage cannot load; this is local rendering and error-state smoke, not cloud-storage proof.
Captured from http://127.0.0.1:8787/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

The freshly reset remote shelf opens empty with the title field, plain-text editor, saved-title list, reader, and D1 + R2 cloud badge on one screen.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

Two snippets are saved on the remote shelf, and selecting Sign-off shows its own Kind regards. body in the reader.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

After a page reload, both remote titles return and Greeting reads Hello, team! from cloud storage.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

Deleting Sign-off removes only that title; the success message is visible while Greeting remains listed and readable.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

A fresh browser context rebuilds the unchanged remote shelf with Greeting present, Sign-off absent, and no reader selection carried over.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

Selecting Greeting in the fresh context reads Hello, team! from the remote D1/R2-backed shelf.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

Submitting text without a title shows the title-required error while Greeting remains the only saved remote snippet.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

Submitting Empty note with spaces-only text shows the text-required error and leaves the remote shelf unchanged.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

Markup-looking content is shown literally as Hello in the plain-text reader on the remote shelf. Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

A real remote save beyond the approved 100-object capacity is rejected with a clear no-capacity message, the Overflow form preserved, and no false success state.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-707e60c64357d9e1197de094.skundu.workers.dev/; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox
